acip: RTAGS DANG PO MA GRUB NA, RTAG PA DANG GCIG CHOS CAN, KHYOD KVA BUM GNYIS DANG 'GAL BA DANG MI 'GAL BA YIN PAR THAL, KHYOD YANG YIN, KVA BUM GNYIS DANG 'GAL BA YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA YOD PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: rtags dang po ma grub na, rtag pa dang gcig chos can, khyod kva bum gnyis dang 'gal ba dang mi 'gal ba yin par thal, khyod yang yin, kva bum gnyis dang 'gal ba yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa yod pa'i phyir
english: I disagree with the first part of your reason: it is not the case that something which is the same as unchanging things is not contradictory to what is contradictory to the pair of a coffee table and a coffee cup. Suppose you do disagree. In that case, let us consider something which is the same as unchanging things. It is so the case that it is not contradictory to what is contradictory to the pair of a coffee table and a coffee cup, Because there does exist something which is both it, and which is contradictory to the pair of a coffee table and a coffee cup.
